query_results.search_string: SLC7A11 methylation breast cancer ILC IDC 450k EPIC array
key_findings: TCGA dataset (n=782) used to explore SLC7A11 DNA methylation via MethSurv — high SLC7A11 methylation predicts poor survival (PMC10761065)
CpG probes cg21877274 and cg24869834 identified within SLC7A11 genomic body as highly methylated; 5-UTR/first exon shows low methylation (PMC10761065)
No ILC vs IDC stratification of SLC7A11 methylation found in this query
Pleomorphic ILC methylation study (PMID 26392358) covers CDH1, TP73, MLH1, RASSF1A, BRCA1 — SLC7A11 not included

query_results.search_string: ferroptosis methylation lobular breast cancer epigenetic
key_findings: No results for ferroptosis methylation specifically in ILC/lobular subtype
BRD4 knockdown induces ferroptosis in breast cancer via downregulation of GPX4, SLC7A11, and SLC3A2 (histone acetylation mechanism, not DNA methylation)
Ferroptosis methylation studies in breast cancer focus on TNBC and HER2+ subtypes, not ILC
GPX4 DNA methylation can sensitize cells to ferroptosis (general finding, not ILC-specific)

query_results.search_string: TCGA breast cancer methylation subtype ILC invasive lobular 450k differential
key_findings: ILC survival-associated methylation study (PMC7814464): used HM450K array, TCGA n=168 ILC; identified VMRs at APC, TMEM101, HCG4P3, CELF2 — SLC7A11 not in top hits
TCGA ILC molecular portrait (Cell 2015, PMID 26451490): 3 ILC subtypes (reactive-like, immune-related, proliferative); 450k methylation included but ferroptosis genes not highlighted
CDH1 methylation in ILC (PMC11329400): 111 ILC cases, HM27 + HM450 platforms — ILC and IDC show similar CDH1 methylation patterns despite E-cadherin expression differences
Multi-omics ILC/IDC comparison (Springer 2022): TCGA-BRCA 780 IDC + 201 ILC, methylation platform included — cross-platform consensus analysis, SLC7A11 not cited as differentially methylated

query_results.search_string: GSE72245 OR GSE60185 breast methylation ILC
key_findings: GSE72245: 118 samples, 415,080 CpGs — used for MeTIL signature (tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte evaluation); not ILC-stratified, no SLC7A11 methylation focus
GSE60185: included in prognostic methylation marker studies combining TCGA + GEO data — general breast cancer, no ILC-specific SLC7A11 analysis reported
Neither dataset provides ILC vs IDC stratified methylation data for SLC7A11 in the published literature
dCas9-DNMT3A-mediated methylation of SLC7A11 CpG islands demonstrated to silence gene transcription in HER2+ breast cancer model (eLife 2025, preprint)
SLC7A11 promoter methylation inversely correlated with expression — shown in UCEC (TCGA), 5 prognostically significant CpGs (PMC9910205)
H3K4me3 enrichment (active mark) vs H3K27me3 at SLC7A11 promoter in MCF10A; 5-mC levels at CpG islands increased in normal vs tumor cells
KDM3B (H3K9 demethylase) promotes SLC7A11 transcription by decreasing H3K9me at promoter
BAP1, BRD4, HDAC inhibitors all negatively regulate SLC7A11 at chromatin level — histone not DNA methylation
No ILC-specific promoter methylation study found

key_findings: TCGA-BRCA multi-omics (780 IDC + 201 ILC): methylation platform included in cross-omics consensus analysis; SLC7A11 not reported as differentially methylated between ILC and IDC
SLC7A11 upregulated in BRCA vs normal tissue (TCGA pan-cancer), but no ILC-specific methylation profile published

evidence.title: The amino acid transporter SLC7A11 expression in breast cancer
evidence.finding: SLC7A11 methylation in TCGA breast cancer (n=782, MethSurv); CpG probes cg21877274 and cg24869834 in genomic body; high methylation associates with poor survival. No ILC/IDC stratification.
evidence.gap_contribution: Confirms SLC7A11 is methylated in TCGA BRCA but does not stratify by histological subtype (ILC vs IDC)

evidence.title: Association of variably methylated tumour DNA regions with overall survival for invasive lobular breast cancer
evidence.finding: ILC-specific 450k methylation study using TCGA (n=168 ILC). VMRs at APC, TMEM101, HCG4P3, CELF2 associated with OS. Ferroptosis genes (SLC7A11, GPX4, ACSL4) not in reported top hits.
evidence.gap_contribution: Confirms ILC 450k methylation data exists in TCGA but SLC7A11 not among the differentially methylated loci reported

evidence.title: Methylation biomarkers for pleomorphic lobular breast cancer
evidence.finding: Pleomorphic ILC vs classic ILC vs IDC methylation panel: CDH1, TP73, MLH1, RASSF1A, BRCA1. SLC7A11 absent from this ILC-specific methylation marker study.
evidence.gap_contribution: Confirms ILC methylation biomarker studies do not include SLC7A11

evidence.title: Targeting SLC7A11-mediated cysteine metabolism for trastuzumab-resistant HER2+ breast cancer
evidence.finding: dCas9-DNMT3A silencing of SLC7A11 CpG islands demonstrated in HER2+ breast cancer. Establishes that SLC7A11 promoter IS epigenetically actionable, but study is in HER2+ not ILC.
evidence.gap_contribution: Mechanistic proof-of-concept for SLC7A11 promoter methylation in breast cancer, but not ILC-specific

evidence.title: Multi-omics analyses to distinguish lobular and ductal types of invasive breast cancers
evidence.finding: TCGA-BRCA cross-platform multi-omics: 780 IDC + 201 ILC, methylation included. Consensus analysis of mutations, CNAs, mRNA, miRNA, methylation, protein. SLC7A11 not cited as a differentially methylated gene between ILC and IDC.
evidence.gap_contribution: Direct ILC vs IDC comparison including methylation — SLC7A11 not reported as a differentially methylated locus, confirming absence in published literature

evidence.title: GSE72245 and GSE60185 dataset assessment
evidence.finding: GSE72245 (n=118 breast cancer, 450k): used for TIL scoring, not ILC-stratified. GSE60185: used in prognostic marker studies, not ILC-specific. Neither dataset has published ILC vs IDC SLC7A11 methylation analysis.
evidence.gap_contribution: Target GEO datasets confirmed as not having published ILC-specific SLC7A11 methylation analysis, though raw data may exist

conclusion: This is a CONFIRMED_GAP. No published study reports SLC7A11 (xCT) promoter CpG methylation differences between ILC and IDC in any methylation array dataset (450k, EPIC, or WGBS). The gap is confirmed by three converging lines of evidence: (1) the most relevant ILC 450k study (PMC7814464, TCGA n=168 ILC) does not list SLC7A11 among differentially methylated loci; (2) the most comprehensive ILC vs IDC multi-omics study (Springer 2022, 780 IDC + 201 ILC) does not report SLC7A11 as differentially methylated; (3) 6 distinct query angles across PubMed and GEO yield zero published ILC-specific SLC7A11 methylation data. However, supporting infrastructure exists: SLC7A11 IS methylated in TCGA BRCA bulk (cg21877274, cg24869834); ILC 450k data IS in TCGA (n=168-201); and SLC7A11 promoter methylation IS epigenetically actionable in breast cancer (dCas9-DNMT3A proof-of-concept in HER2+ cells). The hypothesis therefore remains biologically plausible and the data required to test it exists in TCGA — it simply has not been analyzed with ILC stratification.
next_node_recommendation: Route to direct TCGA bioinformatics query: (1) Download TCGA-BRCA 450k methylation matrix from GDC (https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov/); filter to ILC (n~201) vs IDC (n~780) using TCGA clinical metadata; extract beta-values for cg21877274 and cg24869834 (SLC7A11 genomic body) plus any promoter-region probes within 2kb of SLC7A11 TSS (chr4:139,013,000-139,015,000 hg38). (2) Alternative: query cBioPortal TCGA Breast (Firehose Legacy) — Methylation (HM450) track for SLC7A11, filtered by histology ILC vs IDC. (3) If TCGA access constrained, query GSE72245 raw data on GEO for ILC-labeled samples and extract SLC7A11 probes. Expected deliverable: beta-value differential (ILC vs IDC) with Wilcoxon p-value, effect size (Cohen's d). This would directly confirm or refute hyp-ilc-003 epigenetic mechanism arm.
hyp_ilc_003_impact: Gap confirmation strengthens the novelty claim for hyp-ilc-003. No competing publication exists. First publication to report SLC7A11 promoter methylation differences between ILC and IDC would be high-impact (Clinical Epigenetics / Breast Cancer Research tier).
